# Reporter Assay Pipeline
> Operator documentation for reporter activity analysis and cap-selected RNA endpoint tracks (0.2.0b4).

Software (access required): [DignoMor/reporter-assay-pipeline](https://github.com/DignoMor/reporter-assay-pipeline).

## Start
- [Home](https://haiyuan-yu-lab.github.io/reporter-assay-pipeline-doc/): Choose reporter or cap assay
- [Quickstart](https://haiyuan-yu-lab.github.io/reporter-assay-pipeline-doc/quickstart/): Install and verify the package

## Learn
- [Assay overview](https://haiyuan-yu-lab.github.io/reporter-assay-pipeline-doc/assay-model/): How the assays differ
- [Reporter assay concepts](https://haiyuan-yu-lab.github.io/reporter-assay-pipeline-doc/reporter-assay-concepts/): PreTran, PostTran, branches, and identifiers
- [Reporter assay normalization](https://haiyuan-yu-lab.github.io/reporter-assay-pipeline-doc/reporter-assay-normalization/): Released Step 9 method and interpretation
- [Cap assay concepts](https://haiyuan-yu-lab.github.io/reporter-assay-pipeline-doc/cap-assay-concepts/): RNA strand and endpoint measurements
- [Glossary](https://haiyuan-yu-lab.github.io/reporter-assay-pipeline-doc/glossary/): Shared assay terminology

## Run
- [Reporter workflow](https://haiyuan-yu-lab.github.io/reporter-assay-pipeline-doc/workflow/): Nine-step reporter analysis
- [Reporter inputs](https://haiyuan-yu-lab.github.io/reporter-assay-pipeline-doc/input-preparation/): Readiness checklist
- [Reporter troubleshooting](https://haiyuan-yu-lab.github.io/reporter-assay-pipeline-doc/reporter/troubleshooting/): Reporter FAQ and recovery guidance
- [Reporter complete run example](https://haiyuan-yu-lab.github.io/reporter-assay-pipeline-doc/complete-command-paths/): Grouped and individual commands
- [Prepare reporter libraries](https://haiyuan-yu-lab.github.io/reporter-assay-pipeline-doc/steps-1-2/): Steps 1–2
- [Build reporter identifier map](https://haiyuan-yu-lab.github.io/reporter-assay-pipeline-doc/steps-3-5/): Steps 3–5
- [Quantify reporter replicates](https://haiyuan-yu-lab.github.io/reporter-assay-pipeline-doc/steps-6-8/): Steps 6–8
- [Call reporter activity](https://haiyuan-yu-lab.github.io/reporter-assay-pipeline-doc/steps-9/): Step 9
- [Cap workflow](https://haiyuan-yu-lab.github.io/reporter-assay-pipeline-doc/cap-selection/workflow/): Cap assay topology and outputs
- [Cap inputs and reference](https://haiyuan-yu-lab.github.io/reporter-assay-pipeline-doc/cap-selection/prepare-inputs/): Read and reference preparation
- [Cap Steps 1–3](https://haiyuan-yu-lab.github.io/reporter-assay-pipeline-doc/cap-selection/steps-1-3/): Read preparation and alignment
- [Complete cap run example](https://haiyuan-yu-lab.github.io/reporter-assay-pipeline-doc/cap-selection/complete-run/): Steps 1–4 and reference preparation
- [Generate cap endpoint tracks](https://haiyuan-yu-lab.github.io/reporter-assay-pipeline-doc/cap-selection/step4/): Step 4 output guide
- [Cap troubleshooting](https://haiyuan-yu-lab.github.io/reporter-assay-pipeline-doc/cap-selection/troubleshooting/): Diagnose cap workflow failures
